tasks.title: Vibrio Bacteria
paras: Vibrio bacteria are a type of bacteria commonly found in coastal waters. These bacteria are known for their ability to cause a variety of infections in humans, ranging from mild gastroenteritis to severe wound infections. Vibrio species thrive in warm, salty environments, making them particularly prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. There are more than twenty different species of Vibrio bacteria, with Vibrio cholerae, Vibrio parahaemolyticus, and Vibrio vulnificus being the most well - known.

One of the most concerning aspects of Vibrio bacteria is their increasing resistance to antibiotics. Over time, some strains of Vibrio have developed mechanisms to evade the effects of commonly used antibiotics. Researchers are working to understand the genetic mutations that contribute to this resistance, which could lead to the development of more effective treatments.

Additionally, climate change is amplifying the risks associated with Vibrio bacteria. Rising sea temperatures and changing salinity levels create ideal conditions for these bacteria to multiply. As a result, there has been a noticeable increase in Vibrio - related infections in regions previously unaffected. This trend underscores the importance of monitoring environmental changes and implementing public - health strategies to mitigate the impact of these bacteria.

questions.stem: The word “prevalent” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：词汇题 原文定位：…making them particularly prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. 解析：prevalent 意为普遍的、广泛存在的。 选项分析： A. widespread 广泛分布，词义匹配，正确 B. limited 有限的，含义相反 C. dangerous 危险的，语境不符 D. rare 稀少的，含义相反

questions.stem: All of the following are true of Vibrio bacteria species EXCEPT:

options.A: Most species are located in the waters along coastlines.
options.C: There are more than twenty total species.
options.D: Certain species are more well known than others.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：ranging from mild gastroenteritis to severe wound infections /more than twenty different species 解析：原文说明弧菌感染有轻微也有严重，并非所有种类都造成重度感染。 选项分析： A. 大多分布在沿岸海域，原文首句，排除 B. 所有物种都造成严重感染，表述绝对错误，正确 C. 共有二十多种，原文提及，排除 D. 部分物种更为知名，原文对应，排除

questions.stem: What does the passage identify as an important concern about Vibrio bacteria today?

options.A: They are becoming less common in tropical regions.
options.B: They are causing fewer health problems in humans.
options.C: Certain kinds are mutating more rapidly than other kinds.
options.D: Certain kinds have become resistant to an important drug.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：…increasing resistance to antibiotics…some strains of Vibrio have developed mechanisms to evade antibiotics. 解析：如今弧菌最大隐患之一：对抗生素产生耐药性。 选项分析： A. 热带地区越来越少，与文意相反 B. 人类健康危害减少，原文风险上升，错误 C. 部分变异速度更快，文中未对比变异快慢 D. 部分菌株产生药物耐药性，贴合原文，正确

questions.stem: Why does the author mention "climate change"?

options.A: To suggest that it has no effect on Vibrio bacteria
options.B: To explain why Vibrio bacteria are not found in cold waters
options.C: To help explain why certain types of infections have been spreading to formerly unaffected areas
options.D: To indicate another reason that antibiotics contribute to bacterial resistance

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：climate change is amplifying the risks…in regions previously unaffected. 解析：气候变化优化生存环境，导致弧菌感染扩散到原本不受影响的区域。 选项分析： A. 对弧菌无影响，完全相反 B. 解释冷水无弧菌，无依据 C. 说明感染向新区域扩散的原因，正确 D. 解释抗生素耐药，话题混搭错误

questions.stem: Click on the sentence in paragraph 3 that identifies specific environmental conditions associated with a contemporary concern about Vibrio bacteria.

options.A: Additionally, climate change is amplifying the risks associated with Vibrio bacteria.
options.B: Rising sea temperatures and changing salinity levels create ideal conditions for these bacteria to multiply.
options.C: As a result, there has been a noticeable increase in Vibrio - related infections in regions previously unaffected.
options.D: This trend underscores the importance of monitoring environmental changes and implementing public-health strategies to mitigate the impact of these bacteria.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：Rising sea temperatures and changing salinity levels create ideal conditions for these bacteria to multiply. 题型：句子定位题 原文要求：选出写明「具体环境条件」的句子。 解析：该句明确列出两大环境因素：海水升温、盐度变化，是加剧弧菌风险的具体环境条件，完全符合题干要求。 选项分析： 第一句：只提气候变化加大风险，无具体条件。 第三句：讲述感染扩散结果。 第四句：提出应对措施与意义。
